query:
query Documents($id: Int, $afterDate: ISO8601Date, $beforeDate: ISO8601Date, $byBookeeperDocuments: Boolean, $byPendingAssignment: Boolean, $byTrashBin: Boolean, $byWithoutFolder: Boolean, $companyId: Int, $employeeId: Int, $employeeIds: [Int!], $excludedType: String, $folderId: Int, $fromEmployees: Boolean, $ids: [Int!], $incidenceId: Int, $leaveId: Int, $payrollHiringId: Int, $relationships: [String!], $search: String, $sort: String = "", $space: String, $status: String, $type: String) {
  documents {
    _policies {
      companyManageEmployeesFolders {
        can
        __typename
      }
      employeeManageAnyEmployeeFolder {
        can
        __typename
      }
      employeeManageDefaultEmployeeFolder {
        can
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    documents(
      id: $id
      afterDate: $afterDate
      beforeDate: $beforeDate
      byBookkeeperDocuments: $byBookeeperDocuments
      byPendingAssignment: $byPendingAssignment
      byTrashBin: $byTrashBin
      byWithoutFolder: $byWithoutFolder
      companyId: $companyId
      employeeId: $employeeId
      employeeIds: $employeeIds
      excludedType: $excludedType
      folderId: $folderId
      fromEmployees: $fromEmployees
      ids: $ids
      incidenceId: $incidenceId
      leaveId: $leaveId
      payrollHiringId: $payrollHiringId
      relationships: $relationships
      search: $search
      sort: $sort
      space: $space
      status: $status
      type: $type
    ) {
      ...DocumentsDocumentItem
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}

fragment DocumentsDocumentItem on DocumentsDocument {
  id
  _policies {
    edit {
      can
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
  arCreatedAt
  author {
    id
    fullName
    __typename
  }
  company {
    id
    __typename
  }
  contentType
  deletedAt
  employee {
    id
    fullName
    __typename
  }
  extension
  file
  filename
  fileSize
  fileUrl
  folder {
    id
    name
    rootParentFolder {
      id
      name
      __typename
    }
    showOnly
    __typename
  }
  fromTemplate
  incidenceMessageId
  isCompanyDocument
  isPendingAssignment
  leaveId
  notificationStatus
  permissionUpdate
  public
  signatureStatus
  signees
  space
  status
  templateId
  type
  createdAt
  updatedAt
  __typename
}
